question: Who among the following was the President of the United Nations General Assembly?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijay Laxmi Pandit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vijay Laxmi Pandit** was an Indian diplomat and politician, renowned for being the first woman President of the United Nations General Assembly.
 
• She was elected as the President of the **8th session of the United Nations General Assembly in 1953**.
 
• Vijay Laxmi Pandit was the sister of India's first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru, and played a significant role in India's freedom struggle.
 
• She had an illustrious career, serving as India's ambassador to various countries and making significant contributions to international diplomacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **United Nations General Assembly (UNGA)**

 
 
• The UNGA is one of the six principal organs of the United Nations (UN), serving as its main deliberative, policymaking, and representative organ.
 
• All 193 member states of the UN are represented in the General Assembly, making it the only UN body with universal representation.
 
• The General Assembly meets in regular yearly sessions, but special and emergency sessions can also be called.
 
• Its functions and powers are outlined in Chapter IV of the United Nations Charter and include overseeing the budget of the UN, appointing the non-permanent members to the Security Council, receiving reports from other parts of the UN, and making recommendations in the form of General Assembly Resolutions.
 
 
 
• **Role of the President of the UN General Assembly**
 
 
• The President of the UN General Assembly is elected annually by the assembly to serve a one-year term of office.
 
• The President's duties include overseeing the work of the General Assembly, representing the Assembly at official functions, and ensuring that the Assembly's meetings proceed smoothly.
 
• The President also plays a critical role in facilitating discussions and negotiations among member states, ensuring that the voices of all nations are heard.
 
• The position is held on a rotating basis by representatives of different regional groups to ensure balanced representation.
